short.q: Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u fii l-hafla
short.answer: The friends are at the party.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn
short.answer: I go to school on Monday.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-kitaabu ʿalaa t-taawila
short.answer: The book is on the table.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: anaa min Kiiniya
short.answer: I am from Kenya.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: an-naafidhatu nadhiifa
short.answer: The window is clean.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt. (2 marks)
short.answer: I help my mother on Saturday.
short.working: 1 mark for 'I help my mother' and 1 mark for 'on Saturday'.

short.q: Write a short conversation of three lines in which one friend asks about a party and the other answers. Use English letters. (3 marks)
short.answer: A: hal ʿindaka hafla? B: naʿam, ʿindii hafla. A: mabruuk!
short.working: 1 mark for the question, 1 mark for the answer and 1 mark for a suitable closing wish.

short.q: Translate into English: al-kursiyyu jadiid
short.answer: The chair is new.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give three checks you should do after writing a sentence in Arabic. (3 marks)
short.answer: Did I write from right to left? Are the letters neat and joined? Are the dots and marks in place? Does the sentence make sense?
short.working: 1 mark for each valid check.

short.q: Translate into English: laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin
short.answer: Do not play with the knife.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: anaa tilmiidha
short.answer: I am a pupil (girl).
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: haadhihi shams
short.answer: This is the sun.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: unadhdhifu asnaanii
short.answer: I clean my teeth.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: jaddii kabiir
short.answer: My grandfather is old (big in age).
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: aghsilu wajhii
short.answer: I wash my face.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: alʿabu yawma s-sabt
short.answer: I play on Saturday.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: maa ajmala l-bii'a
short.answer: How beautiful the environment is!
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt
short.answer: I help my mother on Saturday.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-kursiyyu ʿinda l-baab
short.answer: The chair is at the door.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: haadhaa jismii
short.answer: This is my body.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain why it is important to know the days of the week. (2 marks)
short.answer: Days help us to plan what to do and to use time well, for example school, homework and rest.
short.working: 1 mark for planning and 1 mark for good use of time.

short.q: Give three tips that help a speaker to use tone and pace well. (3 marks)
short.answer: Speak loudly enough and clearly; speak at a steady speed; pause between sentences; smile when greeting.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid tip.

short.q: Translate into English: ukhtii taqraʾu
short.answer: My sister reads.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: yadii Sagiira
short.answer: My hand is small.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Rearrange the words to make a sentence and translate it: الْخَمِيسِ / يَوْمُ / الْيَوْمُ. (3 marks)
short.answer: الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ. Today is Thursday.
short.working: 1 mark for the first word, 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Translate into English: akhii Sagiir
short.answer: My brother is small.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: fii l-matbakhi taawila wa kursii. (2 marks)
short.answer: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
short.working: 1 mark for each part.

short.q: Translate into English: fii l-ghurfati sariir
short.answer: In the room there is a bed.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: ʿiid mubaarak
short.answer: Blessed festival (Happy Eid).
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Describe how to solve a jumbled sentence. (3 marks)
short.answer: Find the word that names the item; find the position or describing word; put them together in the pattern and read aloud to check.
short.working: 1 mark for each step.

short.q: Write five parts of the body in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example raʾs (head), wajh (face), shaʿr (hair), ʿayn (eye), udhun (ear).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: ash-shamsu haarra
short.answer: The sun is hot.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give three differences between the Arabic and the English alphabets. (3 marks)
short.answer: Arabic is read from right to left; it has no capital letters; letters join and change shape; it uses marks for short vowels; it has sounds like ʿayn and Haa that English does not have.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid difference, up to 3.

short.q: Explain how a spelling bee is played. (3 marks)
short.answer: Teams take turns; a learner says the Arabic word and spells it by naming the letters; correct spelling earns a point.
short.working: 1 mark for teams, 1 mark for spelling by letter names and 1 mark for scoring.

short.q: Write the seven days in Arabic sounds and say what the first five names come from. (5 marks)
short.answer: al-ahad, al-ithnayn, ath-thulaathaa', al-arbiʿaa', al-khamiis, al-jumuʿa, as-sabt. The first five come from the numbers one to five.
short.working: 3 marks for the days (2 for five or six, 1 for three or four) and 2 marks for the numbers clue.

short.q: Translate into English: ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i wal-ghaymu fii s-samaa'i. (2 marks)
short.answer: The sun is in the sky and the clouds are in the sky.
short.working: 1 mark for each half.

short.q: Translate into English: al-baytu kabiir
short.answer: The house is big.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write three instructions about the body in Arabic sounds with meanings. (3 marks)
short.answer: irfaʿ yadaka (raise your hand), ilmis anfaka (touch your nose), aghmiD ʿaynayka (close your eyes).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct instruction with meaning.

short.q: Write in Arabic sounds and translate: 'I eat bread and I drink milk.' (2 marks)
short.answer: aakulu l-khubza wa ashrabu l-haliiba. I eat bread and I drink milk.
short.working: 1 mark for the Arabic sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Name three things that make Arabic writing different from English writing. (3 marks)
short.answer: It is written from right to left; it has no capital letters; most letters join and change shape; short vowels are shown with marks.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid difference.

short.q: Explain what it means to read with fluency and give two tips for reading fluently. (3 marks)
short.answer: Fluency means reading smoothly at a steady speed with correct words. Tips: put a finger under each word; practise at slow and normal speed.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for each tip.

short.q: Complete the word شُكْ_ا with the missing letter and give its meaning. (2 marks)
short.answer: شُكْرًا: the missing letter is raa (ر). It means thank you.
short.working: 1 mark for the letter and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Give three things you can do to listen attentively. (3 marks)
short.answer: Look at the speaker; do not talk while someone is speaking; think about the topic; listen for words you know; ask a question at the end.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid behaviour, up to 3.

short.q: Translate into English: al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba
short.answer: The pen is in the bag.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: marhaban yaa Ahmad
short.answer: Hello, Ahmad.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: fii l-usbuuʿi sabʿatu ayyaam
short.answer: There are seven days in a week.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Blend the syllables and give the meaning: jad + da + tun. (2 marks)
short.answer: jad-da-tun (grandmother). The syllables are read in order and joined.
short.working: 1 mark for the correct word and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a
short.answer: We look after the environment.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: hadiyya li-Aminata
short.answer: A gift for Amina.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Describe a game you can play with a partner to practise the position words. (3 marks)
short.answer: Hide a small object. One learner asks ayna l-qalam? The other answers with a sentence such as al-qalamu taHta l-kursii. Then swap.
short.working: 1 mark for hiding an object, 1 mark for the question and 1 mark for the answer sentence.

short.q: Look at a picture of a birthday party with a cake with a candle and friends standing round the table. Make a prediction and give a reason. (2 marks)
short.answer: The friends will sing and eat the cake, because the cake has a candle and they stand round the table.
short.working: 1 mark for a sensible prediction and 1 mark for a reason from the picture.

short.q: Spell the word الخميس by naming its letters in order. (3 marks)
short.answer: alif, laam, khaa, miim, yaa, siin.
short.working: 3 marks for all six letters in order; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.

short.q: Name four key words about the home in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks)
short.answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), taawila (table).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila
short.answer: The lamp is above the table.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm?
short.answer: How is the weather today?
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: ismii Ahmad
short.answer: My name is Ahmad.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write three Arabic questions about a picture of a party and give their meanings. (3 marks)
short.answer: For example ayna l-kaʿka? (Where is the cake?) man haadhaa? (Who is this?) maadhaa fawqa t-taawila? (What is above the table?)
short.working: 1 mark for each correct question with meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: ar-riihu qawiyya
short.answer: The wind is strong.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give three ways of taking care of your body. (3 marks)
short.answer: Wash hands and face; clean teeth; eat good food; sleep well; play outdoors.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid way.

short.q: Spell the word باب by naming the letters in order, and give its meaning. (3 marks)
short.answer: baa, alif, baa. It means door.
short.working: 1 mark for the letters, 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Explain why poems help us when learning a language. (2 marks)
short.answer: The rhythm and rhyme help us to remember words and to practise pronunciation.
short.working: 1 mark for memory and 1 mark for pronunciation.

short.q: Translate into English: at-taawilatu Sagiira
short.answer: The table is small.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give three points you would check when you assess a friend's reading. (3 marks)
short.answer: Words pronounced correctly; smooth reading without stops; heavy and throat sounds clear; no word skipped.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid point.

short.q: Translate into English: ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i
short.answer: The sun is in the sky.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Say where the pen is if it is in the bag. Write the sentence in English letters and translate it. (3 marks)
short.answer: al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba. The pen is in the bag.
short.working: 1 mark for the item, 1 mark for the position word fii, 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Write three body parts in Arabic sounds with meanings. (3 marks)
short.answer: For example raʾs (head), yad (hand), fam (mouth).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Describe two ways in which your class can look after the school environment. (3 marks)
short.answer: Plant and water trees; put rubbish in bins; keep water clean; sweep the compound.
short.working: 1 mark for each way and 1 mark for a reason.

short.q: Write four Arabic celebration words in English letters with their meanings. (4 marks)
short.answer: For example ʿiid (festival), hafla (party), hadiyya (gift), kaʿka (cake).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Read these sentences and give the day for each activity: (a) adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn (b) alʿabu yawma s-sabt (c) aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad. (3 marks)
short.answer: (a) Monday (b) Saturday (c) Sunday.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct match.

short.q: Translate into English: as-samaku ladhiidh
short.answer: The fish is delicious.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Describe how to make a food chart for the class wall. (3 marks)
short.answer: Draw local foods, write the Arabic name under each picture, colour it and post it on the wall for review.
short.working: 1 mark for drawing, 1 mark for labels and 1 mark for posting or review.

short.q: Write five words about a celebration in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example ʿiid (festival), hafla (party), hadiyya (gift), baaluun (balloon), kaʿka (cake).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

short.q: Name two common foods in your area and write one Arabic sentence about one of them, with its meaning. (3 marks)
short.answer: For example maize and bananas. al-mawzu ladhiidh. The banana is delicious.
short.working: 1 mark for two foods, 1 mark for a correct sentence and 1 mark for its meaning.

short.q: Explain what makes a paragraph coherent. (2 marks)
short.answer: The sentences are about one topic and are in a good order, so they fit together and make sense.
short.working: 1 mark for one topic and 1 mark for a logical order.

short.q: Write أُمٌّ and جَدَّةٌ and give the meaning of each. (4 marks)
short.answer: أُمٌّ (umm) means mother and جَدَّةٌ (jadda) means grandmother.
short.working: 1 mark for each neat correct word and 1 mark for each meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-jawwu baarid
short.answer: The weather is cold.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write four weather words in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks)
short.answer: For example shams (sun), matar (rain), riih (wind), sahaab (clouds).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-baabu kabiir
short.answer: The door is big.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: lii ʿaynaani
short.answer: I have two eyes.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain why your family members are important to you. Give two examples of roles. (3 marks)
short.answer: They love and care for us. For example parents work, cook and pay for school; grandparents share stories and advice; children help at home.
short.working: 1 mark for love and care, 2 marks for two correct roles.

short.q: Translate into English: al-ʿasiiru baarid
short.answer: The juice is cold.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: uhibbu l-ʿasiira
short.answer: I like juice.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give two tips for pronouncing Arabic greetings correctly. (2 marks)
short.answer: Listen to the teacher first and copy; say long vowels for longer than short vowels; practise the throat sounds kh and ʿ.
short.working: 1 mark for each sensible tip.

short.q: Write in Arabic sounds and translate: 'Today is Thursday.' (2 marks)
short.answer: al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis. Today is Thursday.
short.working: 1 mark for the Arabic sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Write five members of the family in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example ab (father), umm (mother), akh (brother), ukht (sister), jadd (grandfather).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

short.q: Write in Arabic sounds and translate: 'The weather is cold.' (2 marks)
short.answer: al-jawwu baarid. The weather is cold.
short.working: 1 mark for the Arabic sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Explain why a speaker should practise before speaking to an audience. (2 marks)
short.answer: Practice helps the speaker to remember words, pronounce them correctly and feel less nervous.
short.working: 1 mark for remembering or pronouncing and 1 mark for confidence.

short.q: Write the Arabic greeting for 'peace be upon you' in English letters and give the reply. (2 marks)
short.answer: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. The reply is wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam.
short.working: 1 mark for the greeting and 1 mark for the correct reply.

short.q: Write four parts of the body in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks)
short.answer: For example raʾs (head), ʿayn (eye), fam (mouth), yad (hand).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Write four weather features in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks)
short.answer: shams (sun), sahaab (clouds), riih (wind), matar (rain).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Name three verbal cues and say how each one helps the listener. (3 marks)
short.answer: Intonation shows questions and statements; speed shows importance or excitement; tonal variation shows feeling.
short.working: 1 mark for each cue with its use.

short.q: List the members of the nuclear family in Arabic (English letters) with their meanings. Give at least four. (4 marks)
short.answer: ab (father), umm (mother), akh (brother), ukht (sister), ibn (son), bint (daughter).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning, up to 4.

short.q: Translate into English: al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis
short.answer: Today is Thursday.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain why you should copy sounds carefully when learning Arabic words. (2 marks)
short.answer: A small change in a sound can change the meaning, and careful copying makes you clear to the listener.
short.working: 1 mark for change of meaning and 1 mark for being understood.

short.q: Describe how a class can make a letter bank. (3 marks)
short.answer: Give each group some letters; write each letter and its name on a card with a picture or word that begins with it; arrange the cards in order in the class portfolio.
short.working: 1 mark for writing cards, 1 mark for adding names or words and 1 mark for arranging them.

short.q: Translate into English: haadhihi ummii
short.answer: This is my mother.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain why neat and legible writing matters when a poem is displayed. (3 marks)
short.answer: Readers can read it easily, the dots and marks show the right words, and neat work shows care and pride.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid reason.

short.q: Write five things or rooms found in a home in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), hammaam (bathroom), hadiiqa (garden).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

short.q: Say what the words abii yaʿmalu and ummii tatbukhu mean, and name one thing each parent does. (4 marks)
short.answer: abii yaʿmalu: My father works. ummii tatbukhu: My mother cooks.
short.working: 1 mark for each translation and 1 mark for each role named.

short.q: Translate into English: haadhaa matar
short.answer: This is rain.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
